ext.about.title: About
page.extension.title: Chrome extension to keep your screen awake — AwakeTab
page.extension.description: AwakeTab for Chrome keeps your screen or computer awake from the toolbar, even when the tab is hidden. Timers, schedules, an honest status and no tracking.
page.extension.lead: The web app can hold a wake lock only while its tab is visible. The extension asks Chrome itself to keep the display awake, or just the computer, so it keeps working when the tab is hidden or the window is minimised.
page.extension.firefox.title: Using Firefox or Safari?
page.extension.firefox.body: Firefox and Safari don’t give extensions a power API, so there is no AwakeTab extension for them. The web app keeps the screen awake while its tab is visible.
page.extension.features.title: What it does
page.extension.features.levels: Screen or System: keep the display on, or keep only the computer awake and let the screen dim.
page.extension.features.timers: The same presets as the web app — 15 minutes to 4 hours, until a time, or until you stop.
page.extension.features.badge: The toolbar badge shows ON, SYS or the minutes left, and Alt+Shift+A toggles it from any tab.
page.extension.features.pro: With Pro: weekly schedules, and auto-start when Chrome opens or when you visit a site you choose.
page.extension.limits.running: It works only while Chrome is running.
page.extension.limits.lid: It can’t stop sleep when you close a laptop lid.
page.extension.limits.presence: It doesn’t keep Teams or Slack showing you as available: presence follows your keyboard and mouse, and AwakeTab never fakes input.
page.extension.permissions.title: Permissions, and why
page.extension.permissions.power: power — hold the display or system keep-awake.
page.extension.permissions.storage: storage — save your settings and the current session.
page.extension.permissions.alarms: alarms — run timers and schedules while the background worker sleeps.
page.extension.permissions.notifications: notifications (optional) — tell you when a timer ends.
page.extension.permissions.sites: Site access (optional, one site at a time) — start automatically on sites you pick. No site access by default.
page.extension.privacy: Anonymous usage statistics are off by default. The extension never sends URLs, tab titles or site names, and it shows no ads.
page.extension.web: Rather not install anything? The web app keeps the screen awake while its tab is visible.
